main_text.p: tus,percuffum virga mare discidit.Eccle.39. Ita po-pulo cedentibus in latere aquis, velut in continenti,iter pervium fuit. Nec cunctatus rex AEgyptius cedetes infequi,mare,quaIudith 5. patebat,ingressus: mox coeuntibus aquis, cum omni exercitu deletus est. TuncPsal.75. Moyses incolumitate suorum, exitio ho-Exod.15.stium virtuteque exultans canticum Do-mino cecinit: idemq; omnis turba virilis ac muliebris sexus fecit. {a}Sed ingressus e-a fos.Sig.[?]remũ,cum jam per triduum iter agerent, aquae penuria urgebat, repertaq; ob ama-ritudinem usui non erat. At tum primumAmara impotentis populi contumacia apparuit,aqua dul cesch.[?] jamq; in Moysen ferebatur cum edoctus a Deo,lignum aquis intulit,cujus hæc vis fuit, ut dulcem saporem fluentis redderet. Exin promotum agmen,apud Elim duodecim fontibus aquarum & septua-ginta arboribus palmarum repertis, con-sedit. Rursum populus famem conquerens,Moysen increpabat, AEgypti servi-tiū cum saturitate ventris desiderans,tumCoturnices & manna, grex coturnicum superne missus castraExod.16. opplevit.Postero autè dic animadvertunt,Ibidem. qui extra castra processerant, parvis qui-Num.11. bufdam filiquis oppletum solum: quarūPsal.77.

page.notes: Marginal references are printed in the right margin and placed beside their lines. The reference "a fos.Sig." and the note "aqua dul cesch." are doubtful. The word "dicanimadvertunt" is printed joined and is copied as printed. The "u" with a tilde in "remũ" and the accent in "autè" are doubtful. The final word "quarū" is printed at the line end and may continue on the next page. "XVII." is printed in the margin beside "aquae penuria" and is a margin marker, not a heading, so it is not transcribed as text.
